ApprovalPolicy.Name: Standalone Approval Policy
ApprovalPolicy.Hint: When a player tries to join via the standalone web client, control whether the GM is prompted to approve.

MenuButton.Name: Swipe VTT Settings
MenuButton.Label: Configure
MenuButton.Hint: Open the Swipe VTT settings dialog

PremiumMenu.Name: Amethyst Circle features
PremiumMenu.Label: Connect to Patreon
PremiumMenu.Hint: GM must connect their Patreon account for access to Amethyst Circle features, like mobile character sheets for supported systems

ImageOptimizerMenu.Name: Image Optimizer
ImageOptimizerMenu.Label: Optimize Scene Images
ImageOptimizerMenu.Hint: This will not affect any scenes on Desktop. Very large images might not load correctly on phones, so this feature generates small versions to load on phones. This does not change the scene config, only selects the smaller image on mobile.

ImageOptimizerPrompt.Title: SWIPE | Create mobile images automatically?
ImageOptimizerPrompt.Content1: If confirmed, Swipe will create smaller copies of scene images for mobile devices and save them as new files on the server, in the folder below. This happens automatically when the GM views a scene that has large images.
ImageOptimizerPrompt.Content2: The original images and scene config are never changed; only new files are added. You can turn this off or run it manually later in Swipe VTT settings.
ImageOptimizerPrompt.FolderLabel: Folder to save optimized images to:

AutoOptimizeScenes.Name: Auto-Optimize Scene Images
AutoOptimizeScenes.Hint: Automatically create mobile-optimized copies of scene images when the GM views a scene. The copies are saved as new files on the server in the optimized images folder; the original images and scene config are never changed.

DisableLargeMapWarnings.Name: Disable Large Map Warnings
DisableLargeMapWarnings.Hint: Stop showing notifications when a player loads a scene image too large for their device.

ShowCheckDialogs.Name: Always Show Roll Dialog
ShowCheckDialogs.Hint: Show the roll dialog with modifiers before making a check. On desktop this can be toggled with Shift+Click.

Scope.DeviceOnlyHint: Only applies on phones and tablets.

Locks.Toggle: Lock for players. Click to cycle: open, soft (your value is applied once, players can change it), locked (players always get your value). Right-click or Alt+click: locked for players while you keep your own value.

Enabled.Name: Enable Mobile Mode on Desktop
Enabled.Hint: Toggle to force mobile UI on desktop for testing - on mobile devices, it is automatically enabled.

DisableIncompatible.Name: Disable Heavy FX Modules
DisableIncompatible.Hint: Disable performance-heavy visual effects on this device: FXMaster, and everything played through Sequencer (BLFX, JB2A, Automated Animations). Token movement animations still play.

LargeMapThreshold.Name: Large Map Threshold
LargeMapThreshold.Hint: Maps larger than this (in pixels) will use optimized rendering. Default: 4096

Enabled.Name: Enable Canvas Freeze
Enabled.Hint: Pause canvas rendering after inactivity to save battery on low-end devices. Canvas unfreezes on touch.

Delay.Name: Freeze Delay (seconds)
Delay.Hint: Seconds of inactivity before canvas freezes. Default: 10

OnCombat.Name: Unfreeze on Combat
OnCombat.Hint: Automatically refresh canvas when combat turn changes.

OnTokenMove.Name: Unfreeze on Token Move
OnTokenMove.Hint: Automatically refresh canvas when a token you control moves.

OnDiceRoll.Name: Unfreeze on Dice Roll
OnDiceRoll.Hint: Automatically refresh canvas when dice are rolled.

CloseSheetOnRoll.Name: Close Sheet on Roll
CloseSheetOnRoll.Hint: Automatically close the character sheet drawer after rolling dice, using items, or casting spells.

OpenChatOnMessage.Name: Auto-Show Chat
OpenChatOnMessage.Hint: When to automatically show the chat popup: for any new message, or only after your own actions.

ChatAutoHide.Name: Chat Auto-Hide
ChatAutoHide.Hint: Hide the auto-shown chat popup again after a delay. When off, it stays open until you close it.

ChatAutoHideSeconds.Name: Chat Auto-Hide Delay
ChatAutoHideSeconds.Hint: Seconds before the auto-shown chat popup hides. (2-10)

WakeLock.Name: Screen stays awake
WakeLock.Hint: While Swipe is open, your screen won't dim or lock on its own. Browsers only allow this on secure connections (https:// or localhost).
WakeLock.Inactive: not active right now (tap anywhere to retry)
WakeLock.Blocked: blocked by the browser (battery saver may be on)
WakeLock.Insecure: unavailable: needs an https:// connection (turn on Keep Awake for a fallback)

KeepAwake.Name: Keep Awake
KeepAwake.Hint: Play silent audio to prevent the browser from suspending when your screen turns off. Keeps your connection to the game alive. Uses a small amount of battery. On http:// connections it also keeps the screen on. On Android, other apps' audio may play a little quieter while it runs.

HideQuickControls.Name: Hide Quick Controls
HideQuickControls.Hint: Hide the floating quick controls. The settings button stays while Swipe controls are on, since Foundry's sidebar is hidden.

SwipeInterface.Name: Enable Swipe controls (mobile)
SwipeInterface.Hint: Use Swipe's quick controls, button stack and chat drawer instead of Foundry's sidebar, scene controls, players list and hotbar. Starts checked on screens smaller than 1280x600 and unchecked on larger ones; you can change it at any size, and your choice stays until the screen crosses that size. Touch gestures, mobile sheets and the avatar carousel work either way. Worlds with the canvas disabled always use Swipe's controls.

HideAvatarCarousel.Name: Hide Avatar Carousel
HideAvatarCarousel.Hint: Hide the character avatar carousel at the bottom of the screen. You can still open sheets by double-tapping tokens on the canvas.

HideMacroButton.Name: Hide Macro Hotbar Button
HideMacroButton.Hint: Hide the macro hotbar toggle button. When visible, it allows you to open the macro hotbar in a drawer.

SpeakerOnlyAV.Name: Speaker-Only Camera Mode
SpeakerOnlyAV.Hint: Only show the camera view of the user who is currently speaking. When nobody is speaking, the GM's camera is shown as fallback.

EnableMobileSheets.Name: Enable Mobile Sheets
EnableMobileSheets.Hint: Use custom mobile-optimized character sheets. Disable to use default Foundry sheets.

LayoutSpacing.Name: Layout Spacing
LayoutSpacing.Hint: Control the size of touch targets. Spacious mode increases button and row heights for easier tapping.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Enable verbose console logging for troubleshooting.

InviteUrlOverride.Name: Invite URL Override
InviteUrlOverride.Hint: Custom base URL for the Connect Phone QR code (e.g. http://26.x.x.x:30000). Use this when players connect via VPN (Radmin, Hamachi, ZeroTier, etc.) or a reverse proxy. Leave empty for auto-detection.

AutoCreateMobileDuplicate.Name: Auto-Create Mobile Profile
AutoCreateMobileDuplicate.Hint: When a GM opens the Swipe QR Code dialog for a player, automatically create a '(Swipe)' duplicate user for phone login. The duplicate shares the player's character and ownership. Disable to require manual creation via the dialog's Create button.

StandaloneSkipAuth.Name: Skip Standalone Authentication
StandaloneSkipAuth.Hint: Allow players to access the standalone phone app without entering a password. Enable this if you use an external hosting service (e.g. Sqyre) or if your players have trouble connecting.

AutoApproveStandalone.Name: Auto-approve mobile connection requests
AutoApproveStandalone.Hint: When enabled, players joining via the standalone web client are admitted automatically without an approval prompt. Leave off to manually approve each join.

ModuleEnabled.Name: Enable Swipe in this client
ModuleEnabled.Hint: Master switch for Swipe VTT in this client. When unchecked, the module is fully disabled (no mobile UI, no hooks, no premium loading). Requires reload.

ShowMemoryMonitor.Name: Show Memory Monitor
ShowMemoryMonitor.Hint: Display real-time memory usage (JS Heap + GPU Textures) in the Players list next to Latency and FPS.

AllowMiniCanvas.Name: Allow players to use simplified Token Map
AllowMiniCanvas.Hint: Allow players to enable the simplified token map when in Sheet mode. This shows a lightweight grid with token positions instead of the full canvas.

EnableMiniCanvas.Name: Enable Simplified Token Map
EnableMiniCanvas.Hint: Show a simplified token map with grid and token positions when in Sheet mode. Requires GM permission.

MiniCanvasShowWalls.Name: Show Walls on Simplified Token Map
MiniCanvasShowWalls.Hint: Show wall geometry within ~60ft of the player's selected token on the simplified token map. Secret doors are hidden. Disable to prevent players from seeing walls.

MiniCanvasPrompt.Title: Simplified Token Map
MiniCanvasPrompt.Content: Would you like to enable the simplified token map? It shows a lightweight grid that allows you to move tokens, select targets and place templates even in Sheet mode.

DisableAAAnimations.Name: Disable Automated Animations
DisableAAAnimations.Hint: Disable JB2A / Automated Animations on this device to improve performance.

DisableDiceSoNice.Name: Disable Dice So Nice
DisableDiceSoNice.Hint: Disable 3D dice animations on this device to improve performance.

DSNShadowsOff.Name: Dice So Nice: No Shadows
DSNShadowsOff.Hint: Turn off 3D dice shadows on this device. Shadows are the heaviest part of the dice render and can crash the GPU on some phones, which blanks the map until reload.

DisableCanvas.Name: Disable Canvas
DisableCanvas.Hint: If your device really struggles, disable the game canvas entirely to use the sheet/roll functionality.

ExpandedSheet.Name: Use Full Page Sheets (Tablets)
ExpandedSheet.Hint: When canvas is disabled, show multiple character sheet sections side-by-side using the full screen. Requires canvas to be disabled.

OverrideDiceSoNice.Name: Dice So Nice Override
OverrideDiceSoNice.Hint: Override performance mode setting for 3D dice. 'Default' follows your performance mode.

OverrideAAAnimations.Name: Automated Animations Override
OverrideAAAnimations.Hint: Override performance mode setting for JB2A animations. 'Default' follows your performance mode.

PowerSaver.Title: Power Saver

LimitFps.Name: Limit FPS to 30
LimitFps.Hint: Reduces frame rate to save battery and improve performance.

DisableAnimations.Name: Disable Light/Vision Animations
DisableAnimations.Hint: Stops flickering lights and smooth vision transitions.

UseNativeResolution.Name: Disable Pixel Ratio Resolution
UseNativeResolution.Hint: Render at native resolution instead of high-DPI. Reduces sharpness but significantly improves performance.

PowerSaver.DialogContent: Your device appears to be struggling with this scene. Enable Power Saver Mode to reduce heating and improve responsiveness?

Settings.PremiumFeature: Amethyst Circle feature - Connect to unlock

NoCanvasBackgroundEnabled.Name: Background Image (Sheet-only Mode)
NoCanvasBackgroundEnabled.Hint: Show a background image when canvas is disabled. Uncheck for a black background.

NoCanvasBackground.Name: Custom Sheet-Only Background
NoCanvasBackground.Hint: Choose a custom background image for users on Sheet-Only mode. Leave empty to use the default.

PartyGroupActor.Name: Party Actor
PartyGroupActor.Hint: Select a Group actor to use as the party. Members will appear in the carousel for all players who have at least Limited permission.

OneFingerDrag.Name: One finger drag on map canvas
OneFingerDrag.Hint: What a single finger dragged across the map canvas does. "Move the map" pans (two fingers still pan and pinch-zoom); toggle the Select Tokens quick control to draw a selection rectangle instead. "Select tokens" keeps Foundry's drag-to-select.

Notifications.MobileDetected: Swipe VTT: Mobile device detected, enabling touch controls
Notifications.DiceDisabled: Swipe VTT: Disabled 3D dice for better performance
Notifications.LargeMapOptimized: Swipe VTT: Large scene detected, using optimized rendering
Notifications.LargeUnoptimizedImages: Scene "{scene}" has large images that may not load on some mobile devices. Swipe VTT can create mobile-friendly versions for you, that will load only on mobile phones. Find the option in the module's settings - Optimize Images
Notifications.PlayerOversizedTexture: Player "{player}" tried to load a scene image too large for their device ({width}x{height}, max {maxTexture}px). Use Image Optimizer in Swipe VTT settings to create mobile versions.
Notifications.AutoOptimized: Swipe VTT: Auto-optimized {count} image(s) for scene "{scene}" for mobile devices.
Notifications.DSNSafariOptimized: Swipe VTT: Adjusted Dice So Nice settings for Safari compatibility
Notifications.SafariIOSWarning: Foundry VTT does not work well on iOS Safari. For a better experience, please use Chrome (or another Chromium browser) instead.
Notifications.MovementNoGM: GM must be online to move tokens.

DesktopEnableWarning.Title: Enable Mobile Mode on Desktop
DesktopEnableWarning.Content: This setting is meant for touch enabled laptops or testing with Chrome Device Simulator. It may cause issues on regular browser. Are you sure you want to enable?

DiceSoNicePrompt.Title: Dice So Nice
DiceSoNicePrompt.Content: 3D dice animations can impact performance on mobile devices. Would you like to disable Dice So Nice?

iOSAAPrompt.Title: Automated Animations on iOS
iOSAAPrompt.Content: Transparent videos from JB2A show with black background on iOS. This is not something Swipe VTT can fix. Would you like to disable Automated Animations?

ImageOptimizer.title: Scene Image Optimization
ImageOptimizer.description: Some mobile devices won't load large images. Swipe-VTT can replace the images on mobile devices for you with optimized versions and save in the indicated folder. IMPORTANT: This will NOT change your current scenes - it will simply generate mobile images that will be used in mobile only
ImageOptimizer.waitForAnalysis: Please wait for analysis to complete.
ImageOptimizer.noOptimizationNeeded: All scenes are optimized or have no large images.
ImageOptimizer.noScenesFound: No scenes found in this world.
ImageOptimizer.note: Optimized images will be resized to max 4096px and compressed as WebP. Original files are preserved.
ImageOptimizer.folderLabel: Folder to save optimized images to:
ImageOptimizer.folderNote: If you delete or change the folder, images may not be found anymore. Make sure to select one folder for all images and update here if folder is manually moved.
ImageOptimizer.folderHint: Folder will be created when optimization starts. You can change this or browse to select an existing folder.
ImageOptimizer.videoWarning: Video backgrounds cannot be optimized. For better mobile performance, consider using a static image or pre-converting videos to 720p H.264 format.
ImageOptimizer.dontAskAgainCheckbox: Don't ask again for unselected scenes
ImageOptimizer.mobileNote: Mobile clients will automatically use optimized versions when available.
ImageOptimizer.StaleEntriesFound: {count} optimized image(s) are registered but their files are missing from disk. (Optimized files that still exist but were saved with an invalid name are repaired automatically — they are not listed here.)
ImageOptimizer.StaleEntriesClear: Clear these entries from the registry? The affected scenes will fall back to their original images until you re-optimize them.
ImageOptimizer.LegacyEntriesRepaired: Swipe VTT: Repaired {count} optimized image path(s) that were saved with an invalid name.

WebGLLost.Title: Graphics memory ran out
WebGLLost.Body: Your device ran low on memory and the map had to stop rendering. Close other browser tabs and background apps to free memory, then reload.

QuickControls.LogoutConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to log out?
QuickControls.DeleteSelectedRegionsConfirm: Delete {count} selected region(s)? This can't be undone.
QuickControls.NoTemplatesSelectRegion: No templates on canvas. Tap a region to select it, then tap the trash to delete it.
QuickControls.DeleteTemplatesFailed: Could not delete: you don't have permission to remove these.

Sheet.RotateToPortraitHint: This sheet works best in portrait orientation
Sheet.LimitedPermission: You have limited access to this character.

PF2E.NoPublicDetails: Nothing has been shared about this character.
PF2E.NoValidFormulas: No known formulas can be prepared here

CoC7.DailySanResetHint: Reset the daily sanity loss counter to 0?
CoC7.GroupCardHint: Difficulty and bonus dice are set on the card for each participant.

PerformanceMode.Intro: Based on device's capabilities, Swipe suggests {recommendedMode} mode.
PerformanceMode.SaveFailed: Could not save your choice — the GM is offline. Try again once they are online.

AutoOptimize.Name: Auto-Escalate If Struggling
AutoOptimize.Hint: If FPS stays low, prompt to enable a higher performance mode.

Minimal.Name: Minimal
Minimal.Desc: No performance changes other than loading optimized mobile images. For flagship devices only.
Minimal.Warning: May heat up your device. Test and switch if necessary.

Balanced.Name: Balanced
Balanced.Desc: Lowers FPS to 30, freezes canvas when idle, and disables some heavy effects modules. Good balance of quality and battery life.

Aggressive.Name: Aggressive
Aggressive.Desc: All Balanced optimizations, plus disables Automated Animations, offers to disable Dice So Nice, and uses lower resolution rendering.

SheetOnly.Name: Sheet-Only
SheetOnly.Desc: Disables the map rendering, but keeps certain Foundry functionality. For heavy worlds or devices struggling with Foundry.

Standalone.Name: Standalone
Standalone.Desc: Lightweight standalone page that bypasses Foundry's client. Best for access to character sheet on iPhones or low-memory devices, but lacks many Foundry features.
Standalone.Unavailable: Not available right now — the GM needs to connect Swipe VTT to Patreon in this world.

PerformanceMode.StandaloneLegacy: Standalone (unavailable on V14 — treated as Sheet-Only)

Escalation.Title: Performance Still Low
Escalation.Message: Your device is experiencing low frame rates ({fps} FPS). Would you like to try {nextMode} mode?

PerformanceMode.ReloadPrompt: Performance mode settings have been saved. A page reload is required for all changes to take effect.

ConnectPhone.Title: Swipe QR Code
ConnectPhone.Instructions: Scan this QR code on your phone to connect with the mobile user.
ConnectPhone.DontShowAgain: Don't show this on load (reopen on user config dialog)
ConnectPhone.DisconnectHint: Revoke this user's standalone access. They must be approved again to reconnect.
ConnectPhone.DisconnectConfirm: Revoke standalone access for {name}? Any active standalone session will be disconnected and they'll need approval to reconnect.

MobileDuplicate.CreateHint: Creates a paired '(Swipe)' user so this player can log in on a phone without conflicting with their desktop session.
MobileDuplicate.Created: Mobile profile '{name}' created. Player can now scan the QR to log in.
MobileDuplicate.ResyncHint: Copy role, character, color, and actor ownership from the player to the mobile profile.
MobileDuplicate.Resynced: Mobile profile re-synced from player settings.
MobileDuplicate.DeleteHint: Remove the mobile profile. The player will no longer be able to log in on a phone via this QR.
MobileDuplicate.DeleteConfirm: Remove the mobile profile? The player can no longer log in on a phone until you create it again.
MobileDuplicate.SetPasswordHint: Set or clear the mobile profile's login password.
MobileDuplicate.PasswordHint: Leave empty for login without password. This only affects the Swipe mobile account - password is not copied from original user.

MenuButton.Name: Cleanup Utility
MenuButton.Label: Clean Up Orphaned Settings
MenuButton.Hint: Every module you installed leaves settings behind. Scan for and remove orphaned settings left by disabled or uninstalled modules - it might save world loading time.

SettingsCleanup.Title: Orphaned Module Settings
SettingsCleanup.Description: These settings belong to modules that are no longer active. Removing them can help reduce a bit of world loading time.
SettingsCleanup.NoOrphansFound: No orphaned settings found. Your world is clean!
SettingsCleanup.NoneSelected: Please select at least one module to clean up.
SettingsCleanup.ConfirmMessage: Delete {count} orphaned setting(s)? This cannot be undone.
SettingsCleanup.DeletedSummary: Deleted {world} world setting(s) and {client} client setting(s).
SettingsCleanup.Note: Only settings from inactive or uninstalled modules are shown. Active module, system, and core settings are never affected.

MenuButton.Name: Memory Diagnostics
MenuButton.Label: Open Memory Diagnostics
MenuButton.Hint: Analyze memory usage by module and asset type. Helps identify what is consuming resources on mobile devices.

MemoryDiag.EstimatedTotalHint: JS Heap (includes module code + documents) + GPU Textures
MemoryDiag.DocumentsIntro: Everything in the World sidebar is loaded into memory for every connected client. Keep actors, items, and scenes in compendium packs when not actively in use — they are only loaded on demand and won’t slow down your world.
MemoryDiag.Name: Name
MemoryDiag.SkippedLargeCollection: Skipped sizing for {count} entries (too large). Count shown only.
MemoryDiag.WorldVsCompendiumHint: World documents include serialized data plus derived data from system preparation. Compendium counts show index entries only — full documents are lazy-loaded on access and not counted here. The bar reflects memory ratio (bytes), not count ratio.
MemoryDiag.DiskUsageHint: Actual file sizes on the server for each data collection.
MemoryDiag.GMRequired: Server disk sizes are only available to the GM.
MemoryDiag.PerSceneHint: Estimated GPU memory cost per scene. Active/viewed scenes have textures loaded.
MemoryDiag.NoIssuesFound: No issues found. Your world looks healthy!
MemoryDiag.UsageInactiveHint: See exactly which documents are touched during a session. Tracking must start at world init, so enabling requires a page reload. After reload, use the world normally for a few minutes, then reopen this dialog. Untouched documents are candidates for moving to a compendium.
MemoryDiag.UsageActiveHint: Tracking active for {elapsed}. Counts show docs that have been accessed by code or rendered into a sheet. Iteration (sidebar walks etc.) is intentionally NOT counted to keep the signal meaningful.
MemoryDiag.UsageEnableConfirm: This will reload the page so usage tracking can install at init time. After the reload, use the world normally for a few minutes, then come back here to see which documents got touched.
MemoryDiag.UsageDisableConfirm: This will reload the page to remove the tracking hooks.
MemoryDiag.UsageUntouchedTotal: Total memory tied up in untouched documents: {size}. This is roughly how much the world-document portion of the heap could shrink if everything in this state were moved to compendiums (or never instantiated in the first place).

Premium.Description: Connect your Patreon account to use all Swipe features, like optimized character sheets.
Premium.InfoText: Amethyst Circle features include complete mobile character sheets for supported systems. Connect your Patreon account (any tier, including free) to unlock them.
Premium.ConnectionSuccess: Connected as {name}! Amethyst Circle features are now available.
Premium.ConnectionFailed: Failed to connect. Please try again.
Premium.NotPatron: Your account is not linked to an active Patreon membership.
Premium.InsufficientTier: Your tier (${current}/month) doesn't meet the minimum (${required}/month) for Amethyst Circle features.
Premium.InsufficientTierWarning: Your current tier doesn't include Amethyst Circle features.
Premium.PopupBlocked: Popup was blocked. Please allow popups for this site and try again.
Premium.LoggedOut: Disconnected from Patreon. Amethyst Circle features disabled.
Premium.UpgradeHint: Optimized sheets are exclusive to Patreon members. Connect or use regular Foundry sheets.
Premium.UseRegularSheetsConfirm: This device will use regular Foundry sheets. You can turn mobile sheets back on in Swipe settings. Reload now?
Premium.ConnectRequestSent: Your GM was asked to connect Patreon.
Premium.ConnectRequestNoGM: No GM is online right now. Ask them to connect Patreon once they join.
Premium.ConnectRequestFailed: Could not reach the GM. Make sure socketlib is enabled.
Premium.GMConnectRequest: {name} asked you to connect Patreon so they can use optimized character sheets.
Premium.SheetsForcedOn: Your GM has turned mobile sheets on for your account, so they can't be disabled here.
Premium.TokenExpired: Swipe Patreon session expired. GM should reconnect with Patreon to unlock features.
Premium.GMReloadRequest: GM loaded Amethyst Circle features. Reloading...
Premium.LinkCodeHint: Can't use popups? Get a code from another device.
Premium.GetLinkCode: Click to Get an Auth Code

Diagnostics.ConflictCompetingMobile: {modules} conflict with Swipe VTT touch handling. Disable for better stability and lower memory usage.
Diagnostics.ConflictAnimationStack: {count} animation modules active ({modules}). Animation libraries consume significant GPU memory on mobile and don't usually work on iOS.
Diagnostics.ConflictDiceModules: {count} dice modules active. Each adds WebGL textures. Consider keeping only Dice So Nice on mobile.
Diagnostics.ConflictFxModules: {modules}: GPU shader effects increase memory pressure on mobile.
Diagnostics.ConflictMediaOptimizer: Media Optimizer is active alongside Swipe VTT's built-in image optimizer. This may cause conflicts or redundant processing.
Diagnostics.RecActorCount: Your world has {count} actors loaded into memory. Consider moving NPCs to a compendium and importing only when needed.
Diagnostics.RecActorCountHint: Move inactive NPCs to a compendium pack
Diagnostics.RecBloatedActorsHint: Archive unused items to a compendium
Diagnostics.RecChatMessages: You have {count} chat messages. Old messages consume memory on every client.
Diagnostics.RecChatMessagesHint: Use "Flush Chat" or delete old messages
Diagnostics.RecOversizedTexturesHint: Use Image Optimizer to create mobile-friendly versions
Diagnostics.RecStorageSize: Total world data on disk is {size}.
Diagnostics.RecStorageSizeHint: Consider removing unused compendia or cleaning up world data
Diagnostics.RecWorldHeavy: Collections with most documents in world (always loaded into memory)
Diagnostics.RecWorldHeavyHint: Move rarely-used entries to compendium packs
Diagnostics.RecComplexWallsHint: Complex walls increase memory and render time
Diagnostics.WarnTexturesCritical: GPU texture memory is very high ({size}). This will likely cause crashes on mobile.
Diagnostics.WarnTexturesHigh: GPU texture memory is elevated ({size}). May cause issues on low-end devices.
Diagnostics.WarnModulesCritical: {count} modules active. This is extremely high for mobile. Each module adds JS, CSS, and hook overhead.
Diagnostics.WarnModulesHigh: {count} modules active. Consider disabling non-essential modules for mobile sessions.
Diagnostics.WarnDOMComplexity: DOM has {count} elements. High DOM complexity increases memory usage and slows rendering.

UserConfig.Description: Configure mobile mode and performance settings for individual players.
UserConfig.NoUsers: No non-GM users in this world.
UserConfig.ReloadPrompt: Your GM has updated your mobile settings. A reload is required for changes to take effect.
UserConfig.DuplicateHint: Create a paired '(Swipe)' user so this player can log in on a phone without conflicting with their desktop session.
UserConfig.RemoveDuplicateHint: Delete the player's '(Swipe)' user. The QR code on their User Config will stop working until you create a new one.

ActorDirectory.AddToSceneDenied: You do not own that actor, so the GM declined to place it.
ActorDirectory.AddToSceneUnavailable: No GM client could place the token. Ask the GM to reload Foundry so Swipe's handlers are registered.

TokenHud.DeleteConfirm: Delete this token? This can't be undone.
TokenHud.DeleteDenied: You do not own that token's actor, so the GM declined to delete it.
TokenHud.DeleteUnavailable: No GM client could delete the token. Ask the GM to reload Foundry so Swipe's handlers are registered.
